forecast.event: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders
forecast.dataSource: The Odds API schedule; original editorial opinion
forecast.dataPermissionReference: Existing The Odds API terms; owner-provided editorial selection
forecast.rationale: honeymoon is over. Raider won 3 games… they won’t beat the chiefs. Kirko Cousins is good, always has been. But inconsistency has always been a problem. Today is going to be the first game of what people thought the raiders were going to look like before the season started

reason: Final score: Kansas City Chiefs 30, Las Vegas Raiders 27. Chiefs won by 3; the published -4.5-point selection required a margin of at least 5. 30 - 4.5 = 25.5, below 27. Manually verified final result; original pregame selection and rationale retained.
